source.title: A Hedge Fund Manager Just CRACKED Prop Trading (Live On Chart)

taught: [22:53-26:24] NQ, 1-minute bars, long only, one contract
[27:51-28:19] the opening range is recorded from 08:30 to 09:00 Central (09:30-10:00 New York)
[31:28-31:50] 1: one bar closes above the opening range: 'gate number one. It arms the strategy'
[28:42-29:02, 31:28] 2: the price touches the VWAP ('just can touch it')
[29:02, 32:12] 3: a 1-minute bar closes back above the VWAP
[29:26-29:47, 32:12-32:32] 4: ADX above 20 and not increasing 'from the previous bar' (flat or decreasing)
[32:55-33:15] when only the ADX is missing, wait until it is satisfied, then open
[33:15-33:36] 1, 2 and 3 can happen on one candle; the entry is the open of the following bar
[34:17-34:38] take profit at the high of the past five bars; stop loss at the low of the past 20
[34:38] out at 3:55 Central if neither is hit
[1:00:44] the target is a limit order, the stop a market order
[chart 59:35, 2026-09-22] the VWAP line starts at the 08:30 Central open (09:30 New York); one trade on that day: in about 11:10 Central, out at the target about 11:44, both levels fixed at the entry
[ours, 2026-10-11] a signal whose target is nearer than 15 points is not traded; the day goes on and a later signal may trade
not_run: THIS IS NOT THE VIDEO'S RULE: the least target of 15 points is ours, chosen after the taught run was seen (its far-target trades made money, its near-target trades did not). In-sample by construction: only unseen days can judge it. 10, 15 and 20 points run side by side so that no one number is picked.
Trades a day: the video gives no number. The sheet runs ONE trade a day (the simplest reading); his report shows about 122 trades a year.
Exit time: he says 3:55 Central = 16:55 New York. The engine's day ends at 15:58 and the family flattens at 15:55 New York, an hour earlier; no entry from 15:50.

A target less than 2 ticks above the signal close is NO TRADE here (the Template's rule). He says the target sits at the entry candle's own high under 5 % of the time and the trade is taken (it would fill at once, at about the entry).
The stop is never nearer than a quarter of the 1-minute bars' ATR (the Template's floor on a structure stop).
Both levels are fixed at the signal close and move with the fill (1 tick of slippage), so the distances are those of the signal.
The target is the family's own LEVEL, not a multiple of the stop: the lane's three cells (target x 0.75 / 1 / 1.25) are the same cell three times here. There is no neighbourhood to read.
ADX: Wilder's ADX(14) over the 1-minute bars since 00:00 ET of the day; his is a continuous series and its period is not said (14 is the default).
VWAP: volume-weighted (high + low + close) / 3 of the 1-minute bars from 09:30; the video does not say which price it weights.
Arming: the whiteboard says a bar CLOSES above the opening range (run here); at the chart he says the price 'touches' the high of the range.
While waiting for the ADX the bar that trades must itself close above the VWAP (the video does not say what happens when the price falls back under it).
Costs and the order of a stop and a target inside one bar: the engine's own (1 tick of slippage, $4 a round turn, tick replay); his report shows no costs.

THE RANDOM CONTROL IS WEAKER THAN THE RULE: the lane's random entries run in the engine's own nyam pass (09:30-11:00, flat 15:58, the median stop of the taught trades, target = that stop) and do not know the family's 09:30-15:55 window or its level target; read the 'beats random' lines with that in mind.
name: conti_vwap_adx_tp15

entry.words: A 1-minute bar closes above the 09:30-10:00 opening range (armed); the price touches the VWAP; a 1-minute bar closes back above the VWAP with ADX above 20 and not higher than on the bar before: buy at the next bar's open. Target = the high of the past five bars, stop = the low of the past 20, out at the end of the day. OURS, not the video's: only when that target is at least 15 points above the signal close.
